title: Home Purchase Financing Good-Faith Payment — Installments Counted by Loan Age
content:
**Contract seasoning note — installments counted for a Home Purchase Financing good-faith payment**

How many installments the good-faith payment counts as past due depends on how long ago the loan's first installment fell due, measured in whole months before the payment date:

- **First installment 48 or more whole months before the payment date.** The installments past due for the good-faith payment count only the installments that are a whole month or more past due, that is the whole months from the oldest unpaid installment's due date to the payment date.
- **First installment fewer than 24 whole months before the payment date.** They count every unpaid installment falling due on or before the payment date and the next installment as well, that is those whole months plus two.
- **First installment 24 to 47 whole months before the payment date.** The count is not varied by this note.

The first installment's due date is the first payment date on the loan record.

### Cases (hypothetical loans; oldest unpaid installment due 2026-02-01; payment date 2026-04-02; whole months between them: 2)

| First installment due | Whole months to the payment date | Installments past due counted |
|---|---|---|
| 2021-03-01 | 61 | 2 — the installments due 2026-02-01 and 2026-03-01 |
| 2025-01-01 | 15 | 4 — the three due on or before the payment date and the next one |
| 2023-06-01 | 34 | not varied by this note |

*Boundary.* A first installment exactly 48 whole months before the payment date falls in the first rule; 47 does not. A first installment exactly 24 whole months before falls outside the second rule; 23 is within it.
